subject: Kea Clinic go-live: staffing, ownership and week-0 sprint plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jack Miller <jack.miller@keaclinic.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Kea Clinic — signed and next steps for ops kickoff

Hi Irene (and team),

Quick recap now that signature is in — Kea Clinic signed the RDW platform MSA + SOW this morning. Summary for CS intake and week-0 planning:  

- ARR/Commit: $420k/year; initial Dedicated pool with 2x A100 equivalent GPUs.
- Initial scope: Production chat and embeddings for patient triage and intake forms (low-latency reqs).
- First full-data sync window: Sept 18-20 (customer wants a hard stop for testing).
- Security: Kea requires SOC2 evidence + network peering; they asked for an architect on the vendor call.

Attachments: I attached the signed SOW and the initial staffing roster we discussed.

Immediate asks for CS/ops: can you confirm primary PM and implementation lead? Also flag any initial blockers (network, compliance) so we can block time with the customer this week.

Jack / Aisha — thanks again for the speed here. Irene will lead the handoff and Tessa/Monica on the implementation side will coordinate the runbook. Expect a 30–45 minute intro call from CS this week to sync kickoff cadence.

Next steps (sales): I will update the HubSpot deal and send the procurement artifacts to finance.

Cheers,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jack Miller <jack.miller@keaclinic.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@keaclinic.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Aug 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kea Clinic — signed and next steps for ops kickoff

Thanks Karthik — congrats to everyone on the close. I pulled the SOW and staffing attachments into our activation folder (link below).

I have a couple clarifying questions before I assign owners in our tracker:
1) Is the initial data set going to be delivered via SFTP or cloud connector? (Kea noted both in the intake call notes)
2) Does Kea require a dedicated VPC peering or will they use a transit VPN to our regional endpoint?
3) Any regulatory constraints beyond SOC2 (e.g., retained PHI requirements, regional data residency)?

Operationally, propose the following staffing assignments unless objections:
- Implementation Lead (PM): Tessa Morgan — primary contact for sprint planning and timelines.
- Platform Engineer (network & peering): Monica Patel — owns infra onboarding and peering.
- Customer Success Lead: Irene Choi — owns success metrics, escalation path, and acceptance criteria.

If that works I'll open the Week-0 sprint in Jira and set tentative working sessions for Sept 5–7 to triage network and RBAC. Jack/Aisha — please confirm whether your network team can join any of those windows (morning PT preferred).

Irene
